title: The Signature Student Budget Template Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Reusable budgets for different income and expense patterns. The Student Budget Template Database provides ready-made monthly and term budgets for common student situations: on-campus with a meal plan, off-campus with roommates, part-time worker, and international student, each with adjustable line items. Templates compute totals automatically and flag the categories where students most often overspend. The Signature side adds spending-diary analyzers that categorize real spending against the template.
capabilities: Provide term and monthly budget templates for common situations
